title: Order matters
prompt: The first value passed in goes into the first parameter, the second into the second. Return a minus b.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return b - a
hint: Look at the test solve(10, 3): which parameter holds 10?
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return a - b
